test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef4c3911f562976a3988d8ef05907a018a91035eb838b7504eaf1da50cdae6c3.png] 

The logic followed here is based on the alphabetical position pattern:

Option 1: KF – MK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81d0d3f634a80236ea0807dd9360b13675da7cc6a813efb19aca74fcd45579b2.png] 

Option 2: OP – QU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61b70e629dcfeef5ccf91f501812f7a67f017704cbaa8f446a4f89ec21c5ccc9.png] 

Option 3: SZ – UE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb57370d9afc95306735e3b375d275778864df9b370854796bc0652cfd38ebaf.png] 

Option 4: BG – EL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e6cb32a15e12aa6968edaf7bbf2fc45c997d125a4b760cc3ca831ab6f66109c.png] 

Thus, BG – EL does not follow the same pattern.

Hence, the odd one out is** Option 4.**
